_how_to_add: One object per case study. slug becomes the page address (/work/<slug>): lowercase, no spaces. Everything in [BRACKETS] is a placeholder: replace it, or delete optional parts (proof, before_after, samples, quote). Images go in assets/case-studies/<slug>/. If brand matches a name in site.json client_logos, that logo links to the case study and its logo is reused. featured=true shows it on the Home page proof section.
